home.title: Notes
home.emptyDescription: Create your first note to get started.
home.selectDescription: Select a note from the sidebar, or create a new one.
home.deleteDescription: This will permanently delete "{{title}}". This can't be undone.

share.title: Share note
share.description: Manage who can view or edit this note.
share.noShares: No one else has access yet.
share.copyFailed: Couldn't copy automatically — select the link below and copy it yourself.

anonymous.label: Anonymous link
anonymous.desc: When on, the link doesn't include your username and can't be guessed.

publicSlug.label: Custom public link
publicSlug.hint: This address includes your username and can be guessed.
publicSlug.randomSlugFailed: Couldn't generate a random address. Please try again.

slugError.charset: Only letters, numbers, and hyphens are allowed.
slugError.dash: Hyphens can't be at the start or end, or appear twice in a row.
slugError.reserved: This word is reserved and can't be used.
slugError.uuid_like: This looks like an internal ID and can't be used.

state.public: Public — anyone with the link can view

access.title: Access
access.publicDesc: Anyone with the link can view (read-only)
access.confirmHintWithLink_one: This removes {{count}} member and turns off the public link (including its custom public URL).
access.confirmHintWithLink_other: This removes all {{count}} members and turns off the public link (including its custom public URL).

move.title: Move or copy into a group
move.moveRemovesPeople_one: Per-person sharing with {{names}} is removed; if they aren't in the group, they lose access.
move.moveRemovesPeople_other: Per-person sharing with {{count}} people is removed: {{names}}. Anyone not in the group loses access.
move.moveClosesPublicLink: Its public link will be turned off.
move.moveUrlChange: Its address changes to /g/…; the old address forwards to the new one for a month.
move.moveOwnership: You will no longer own it — what you can do with it then depends on your role in the group.
move.copyLead: This creates a copy in "{{group}}"; the original stays as it is. AI edit history and backlinks are not copied.
move.openCopyAlt: You can also open the copy from the sidebar.
move.changedElsewhere: This note was changed elsewhere, so nothing was moved.

groupNote.description: Group members access this note according to their role's permissions. Public links are anonymous only.
groupNote.access: In "{{name}}", every member whose role can read has access.

note.lastEditedTitle: Last edited by {{who}} on {{when}} — click to see what changed
note.transferDataUrl: Pasting embedded images isn't supported. Try dragging the image file instead.
note.transferSaveFirst: This item can't be inserted directly here. Save it as a file first, then drag it in.
note.transferNonImage: Only image files can be inserted here.
note.wikilinkBroken: This linked note no longer exists.

wikilink.createFailed: Couldn't create the note. Please try again.

note.accessRevoked: You no longer have access to this note.
note.linkInvalid: This link is invalid or the note doesn't exist.
note.downgradedToViewer: Your access changed to viewer. This note is now read-only.
note.restoredEditAccess: Your edit access has been restored.

connection.offlineEditing: Editing offline — changes not synced yet

upload.inputLabel: Choose an image file to upload
upload.error: Couldn't upload the file. Please try again.

embed.invalidUrl: Enter a valid http:// or https:// link.

mermaid.escHint: Press Esc or click elsewhere to finish

link.slashSubtext: Insert a link to a URL

login.title: Sign in
login.noMethods: There's no way to sign in right now. Please contact the site administrator.

linkAccount.title: Link your sign-in
linkAccount.body: This email ({{email}}) already has an account. To link {{provider}} to it, prove that the account is yours.
linkAccount.cancelled: This email is already in use. Sign in with its password or with a sign-in service already linked to it, or use a different sign-in account.

changePassword.title: Change your password
changePassword.description: Choose a new password for your account.
changePassword.mismatch: The new password and confirmation don't match.

auth.title: Sign-in
auth.description: Identity providers (OpenID Connect) that people can sign in with. Each sign-in service has its own callback URL to register on the identity provider.
auth.callbackCopyFailed: Couldn't copy. Select the URL and copy it yourself.
auth.secretMissing: No client secret yet. It can't be turned on until one is saved.
auth.notConnected: Hasn't connected successfully yet, so the number of affected accounts may be off. Press Test connection.
auth.insecureIssuer: This issuer uses plain http: tokens and claims travel unencrypted between Knotebook and the identity provider.
auth.testOk: Connection OK. The identity provider reports issuer {{issuer}}.
auth.testScope: Testing reads only the identity provider's configuration. It can't tell whether the client ID or secret is right.

warnings.client_secret_post_not_advertised: The identity provider doesn't list client_secret_post, which Knotebook uses to send the client secret. Sign-in may fail at the last step.
warnings.secret_undecryptable: The saved client secret can't be decrypted (APP_SECRET may have changed). Enter it again.

auth.disableDescription: Accounts and their linked sign-ins are kept, but nobody can sign in with this service until it's turned back on. People who are already signed in stay signed in.
auth.impactLockedOut: Of those, with no other way to sign in: {{number}}
auth.impactUnresolved: This service hasn't connected successfully yet, so these numbers may be off.
auth.deleteDisabledHint: Turn it off before deleting it.
auth.deleteDescription: Linked sign-ins are kept: if you add a service with the same issuer again, those people can sign in with it again.
auth.deleteLegacyNote: This service uses the old callback URL (…/api/auth/oidc/callback). A service you add later gets its own callback URL, so the identity provider's settings would have to change.
auth.turnedOff: This sign-in service was turned off.

create.title: Add sign-in service
create.startsOff: New sign-in services start turned off. Test the connection, then turn it on.

steps.title: Finish setting it up
steps.scopes: Allow the scopes openid, email and profile.
steps.client: Make it a confidential client that sends its secret with client_secret_post.
steps.secret: Copy its client secret, then paste it here with Edit.
steps.finish: Back here, press Test connection, then turn the service on.

edit.title: Edit sign-in service
edit.description: Leave the client secret empty to keep the current one.
edit.secretPlaceholderSaved: Saved. Leave blank to keep it.
edit.sortOrderInvalid: Display order must be a whole number from 0 to 100000.
edit.issuerChangeClearsSecret: Changing the issuer clears the saved client secret and turns this service off.
edit.issuerChangeClearsSecretOnly: Changing the issuer clears the saved client secret.
edit.issuerChangeTurnsOff: Changing the issuer turns this service off. Test it, then turn it back on.

validation.displayNameTooLong: Display name can be at most 40 characters.
validation.issuerScheme: Issuer URL must start with lowercase http:// or https://.
validation.issuerTooLong: Issuer URL can be at most 512 characters.
validation.clientIdTooLong: Client ID can be at most 512 characters.
validation.secretBlank: Client secret can't be only spaces.
validation.secretTooLong: Client secret can be at most 4096 characters.
validation.unstorable: Contains characters that can't be saved.

admin.title: User management
admin.description: Create accounts, grant admin rights, and disable people who have left.
admin.mustChangePasswordNotice: The new account will be required to change its password on first login.
admin.disableDescription: {{email}} will be signed out immediately and lose access until re-enabled.

dialog.createDescription: Everyone you add to the group will see the notes in it.

delete.title: Delete group?
delete.modeLabel: What happens to the notes in this group
delete.transferDescription_one: {{count}} note will become {{name}}'s personal note. Its address changes to /n/…, and the old address forwards to it for a month. Everyone else in the group loses access, and any public link it has is turned off.
delete.transferDescription_other: {{count}} notes will become {{name}}'s personal notes. Their addresses change to /n/…, and the old addresses forward to them for a month. Everyone else in the group loses access, and any public links on them are turned off.
delete.transferDescriptionNoCount: The group's notes will become {{name}}'s personal notes. Their addresses change to /n/…, and the old addresses forward to them for a month. Everyone else in the group loses access, and any public links on them are turned off.
delete.deleteDescription_one: {{count}} note, its attachments and its edit history are permanently deleted. This can't be undone.
delete.deleteDescription_other: {{count}} notes, their attachments and their edit history are permanently deleted. This can't be undone.
delete.deleteDescriptionNoCount: The group's notes, their attachments and their edit history are permanently deleted. This can't be undone.
delete.acknowledge: I understand the notes will be permanently deleted

leave.title: Leave group?
leave.description: You will lose access to the notes in "{{name}}".

settings.title: Groups
settings.description: Groups you belong to. Notes in a group are visible to every member.
settings.empty: You're not in any group yet.

detail.membersDescriptionAdmin: Add people by email. Members see every note in this group.
detail.membersDescriptionMember: Only people whose role can manage members can add or remove members.
detail.lastAdminHint: The only admin can't be demoted or removed. Make someone else an admin first.
detail.dangerDescription: Deleting the group either gives its notes to one of its admins or deletes them with it.

roles.title: Roles
roles.descriptionManage: Each member has one role, and the role decides what they can do. The built-in Admin role can't be changed; the built-in Member role is what new members get, and it can't be renamed or deleted.
roles.descriptionView: Each member has one role, and the role decides what they can do. Only people whose role can manage roles and the group can change these.
roles.readAlways: Every role can read the group's notes, their backlinks and their AI edit history.

create.label: Create
create.description: Create notes in the group, or move or copy a personal note into it. Without Edit, a note you create, move or copy there is read-only for you too.

edit.label: Edit
edit.description: Change the content and title of the group's notes.

delete.label: Delete
delete.description: Delete any note in the group, including ones other people created.

managePublicLink.label: Manage public links
managePublicLink.description: Turn the anonymous public link of the group's notes on and off, and change a note's URL name through the API.

manageMembers.label: Manage members
manageMembers.description: Add and remove people and change their roles — including making anyone, themselves included, an Admin. A group always keeps at least one Admin.

manageGroup.label: Manage roles & group
manageGroup.description: Rename or delete the group, and create, change and delete its roles.

roles.adminLocked: The built-in Admin role always has every permission and can't be changed.

delete.title: Delete role?
delete.description_one: {{count}} member who has this role will become a Member.
delete.description_other: {{count}} members who have this role will become Members.

dialog.title: New role
dialog.description: Name the role and turn on what it allows. You can change both later.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Manage your account and workspace settings.

account.description: Manage your username, password, and API tokens.
account.ssoOnly: This account signs in with SSO.
account.handleDescription: Your username appears in every /n/ and /p/ link you share (token links don't include it). After a rename those links stop working immediately, and the old name can never be used again — not even by you.
account.apiTokensDescription: Give a script or an AI assistant access to your notes on your behalf. A token can list and create notes, and read and write note content — treat it like a password. Tokens are not affected when you change your password; revoke them here instead.
account.apiTokensCleanupHint: OAuth applications unused for 30 days, and tokens that expired more than 30 days ago, are removed automatically the next time anyone creates a token or authorizes an application.
account.apiTokensOnceWarning: Copy this token now — it will not be shown again.
account.apiTokensCreateHint: Name it after whatever will use it, so you can tell tokens apart later.
account.apiTokensCopyFailed: Couldn't copy automatically — select the token above and copy it by hand.
account.apiTokensUnverifiedName: Name is self-reported by the application and is not verified.
account.apiTokensRevokeDescription: Anything using "{{name}}" will stop working immediately. This can't be undone.
account.apiTokensRenameHint: Shown on the AI's name tag and in the edit history. Letters, numbers, dots, underscores and hyphens only (max 32 characters). Leave empty to go back to the default. Press Cancel to leave it unchanged.
account.handleInvalid: 1–32 characters: lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens; hyphens can't lead, trail, or repeat.

ai.title: AI providers & actions
ai.description: Point Knotebook at your own AI endpoint, then choose which quick actions appear in the editor.
ai.baseUrlChangeClearsKey: Changing the Base URL clears the stored API key — enter it again here, or after saving.
ai.keySet: Already set — enter a new value to overwrite
ai.degradedNotice: This provider's stored key can no longer be decrypted. Enter the API key again to restore it.
ai.noKeyNotice: No API key stored — required for a hosted provider, optional for an unauthenticated local one.
ai.deleteProviderDescription: This will remove "{{name}}" and all of its models. This can't be undone.
ai.actionUserTemplateHint: Must include a {{placeholder}} placeholder for the selected text.

panel.title: AI
panel.idle: Select some text and use the toolbar for a partial edit, or pick an action below to run it on the whole note.
panel.applyGuardFailed: The original text changed since this result was generated, so it wasn't applied.
panel.emptyResult: The AI returned an empty result. Nothing was applied.
panel.revertStale: This change can no longer be reverted — the text may have changed since.
panel.rebindNotice: Some [[links]] in the result couldn't be linked automatically.

public.loadError: Couldn't load this page — check your connection and try again.

authorize.redirectTo: After you allow, you'll be sent back to {{host}}
authorize.loopbackWarning: Only allow this if a program you just started on this computer is asking.
authorize.scopesTitle: This application will be able to:

errors.conflict: Something changed while you were doing that. Reload and try again.
errors.group_not_empty: This group still has notes in it, so it can't be deleted.
errors.builtin_role: Built-in roles can't be deleted or renamed, and the built-in Admin role can't be changed.
errors.role_name_taken: That name is already used by another role in this group, or is reserved for a built-in role.
errors.not_admin: The notes can only be handed to one of the group's admins. Pick someone who is still an admin.
errors.registration_disabled: This site isn't accepting new accounts right now. Please contact the site administrator.
errors.oidc_link_expired: This linking request has expired or was replaced. Please sign in again.
errors.oidc_link_proof_mismatch: The identity you signed in with isn't one already linked to this account.
errors.oidc_link_no_proof_method: This email already has an account, but that account has no other way to confirm it's you — no password, and no other sign-in service you can use here. Please contact the site administrator.
errors.oidc_claim_too_long: Your identity provider sent an email address or account ID that is too long to use.
errors.identity_taken: This sign-in identity is already linked to a different account.
errors.identity_already_linked: This account is already linked to a different identity on the same sign-in service.
errors.provider_enabled: Turn this sign-in service off before deleting it.
errors.provider_secret_missing: Enter a client secret before turning this sign-in service on.
errors.oidc_discovery_failed: Couldn't read a usable OpenID Connect configuration from that issuer URL.
errors.password_login_disabled: This site only allows signing in through a sign-in service.
errors.sso_provider_required: Turn on at least one sign-in service before turning off password sign-in.
errors.admin_sso_link_required: Link a sign-in service that is turned on to your own account (in Settings) before turning off password sign-in.
errors.password_already_set: This account already has a password. Use Change password instead.
errors.last_login_method: This is the account's only way to sign in, so it can't be unlinked.
errors.oidc_link_session_mismatch: You're no longer signed in as the account you were linking. Sign in and try again.
